entities.summary: Hanna Hryhorivna Mashutina, known under her pseudonyms Anna Yablonskaya or Hanna Yablonska, was a Ukrainian playwright and poet, and one of the victims of the 2011 Domodedovo International Airport bombing, a suicide bombing.
